notes: INSIDE half of the Sporeling Spore Cannon: a big violet spore chamber with green spores drifting in it, fibrous feed roots, a steel repair hatch, power coupling and five spore sacs that swell violet while charging and glow green when ready. fire: the sacs flash white then deflate. damaged: the chamber has a split and leaks, two sacs withered; disabled: the chamber collapsed and dry, withered. Barrel layer sporeling_spore_cannon_barrel: a fleshy ringed tube with a flared spotted bell mouth that puffs spores; fire: a green-yellow spore burst.
